text:
nina: quick one — noticed span attributes lose the original request_id on retries in our node and java sampleapps when redaction is enabled :thinking_face:
sam: can you sketch the ordering that triggers it?
nina: minimal repro: node sampleapp registers middleware in this order:
```js
app.use(otel.middleware())
app.use(retryMiddleware)  // library mutates/replays headers for retry
app.use(redactionMiddleware) // scrubs headers for logs/wire
```
On the first attempt span.attr request_id=orig-id; on retry logs show <redacted> and the span attribute becomes <redacted> too.
igor: iirc this is because some SDKs set span attributes lazily at export time from the context's header map. If the retry path rewrites headers afterwards, exporter picks up the mutated value.
maya: Java sample differs: filters order is OtelFilter -> RedactFilter -> RetryFilter in some app servers, but in other apps Retry runs before Redact which flips behavior. parity across SDKs is messy.
sam: two high-level fixes: (A) treat request_id as an immutable span attribute: snapshot and set a dedicated attribute when the header is first observed (e.g., redwood.request_id.orig) and never mutate it; (B) confine redaction strictly to wire/log pipeline so it never mutates the context used for spans.
nina: i prototyped (A) in node sampleapp: when otel middleware sees header, do span.setAttribute('redwood.request_id.orig', val) and mark it as sensitive for exporters to redact on export. seems simple.
igor: sounds good, but exporter changes are required so we don't accidentally send raw values to OTLP. we should add an exporter processor that redacts any attribute in a sensitive whitelist and also a unit test that asserts the OTLP payload contains no raw ids.
maya: small gotcha: some retry libraries copy headers into a new object rather than mutate; that preserved behavior in python sampleapp meant python wasn't hit in our earlier incidents. need to document this language parity.
sam: agree. action items: nina -> open sampleapp PR that snapshots orig request_id + tests; igor -> prototype exporter-side attribute-scrubber + add unit tests; maya -> update devex doc 'hook ordering' with a short matrix for node/java/python/go describing common retry/redact patterns; i'll review all PRs.
telemetry-bot: New issue opened: DEVEX-4944 "span request_id mutated on retry when redaction enabled (cross-language parity)" — https://issuetracker.internal/DEVEX-4944
nina: also adding an e2e harness that runs sampleapp with redaction toggled and inspects OTLP test collector for raw values. if anyone has objections to the attribute name 'redwood.request_id.orig' speak now.
igor: +1 to the name, add a test asserting attribute present but redacted at export.
maya: i'll add a short example snippet in docs showing recommended middleware order and an example test (jest + otlp-col) to catch regressions.
sam: quick note: we should avoid changing production exporters behavior for existing customers without opt-in; consider making exporter-scrubber on by default for sampleapps/devex, opt-in for hosted customers while we bake the change.
nina: fair. i'll gate with a feature flag in sampleapp and the exporter patch. thanks folks :thumbsup:
